name: Friction-objection list over dimmed gameplay
looks: Over a dimmed, still shot of gameplay, a list of three short rebuttals stacks down the left edge, each landing in white while the one before it dims to grey, finishing on a fourth line in the accent colour with a highlight bar behind it.
build: list-stack-reveal for the three white lines; the final line gets a highlight-bar treatment instead of dimming: a solid accent rectangle scales in behind it from the left (scaleX 0->1, power2.out) just before the text itself pops in on top.
sound: A tick per line, with a heavier stamp hit under the highlighted final line.
prompt: Knock down the usual objections to trying a product: stack three short 'no X' lines down the frame over a dimmed shot of the product itself, each line landing bright while the last dims, and close the list on a highlighted claim in the brand's accent colour.
